description: List all notebooks currently open in the Pluto session, with each one's run state: pending_run (ids of edited cells not yet run), running (ids of cells queued or running, in notebook order), and execution_allowed (whether Pluto will run code now: false in safe preview, and while the notebook process is stopped, restarting, or crashed). Does not count as reading any cell.
name: list_notebooks

description: Return the code, output, stale flag, and structured error (when errored) of a single cell. Errored cells include an error object with kind, hint, and fixes when Pluto recognizes the failure (e.g. pluto_multi_expression).
name: read_cell

description: See a cell's output as an image (PNG): plots, figures, rendered images. Use to check what a visual output actually looks like; read_cell only describes non-text outputs. Needs the notebook to be running code (not safe preview) unless the output already is a PNG, and waits while the notebook's worker is busy running cells. Outputs with no PNG form (Markdown, HTML, text) fail with no_image; use read_cell for those. Renders over 4 MB fail with image_too_large.
name: view_cell_output

description: Replace the code in a cell. Requires a prior read_cell or read_notebook_code on this cell. Stages the edit by default (run_after=false); call submit_changes to run staged cells. After a successful edit, the server records a read receipt for the new code (satisfies read guard for your own staged edits only).

run_after.description: Run the cell after updating (non-blocking). Default: false.

name: edit_cell

description: Batch stage cell code edits. Each cell must have been read first. All-or-nothing on read guard failure. Never runs cells; call submit_changes to execute staged edits. After success, read receipts are updated for each edited cell.

cells.description: Array of {cell_id, code} objects to stage.

name: edit_cells

description: Insert a new cell into the notebook. after_cell_id is required when the notebook is not empty; that anchor cell must have been read first. Records a read receipt for the new cell (same as edit_cell).

after_cell_id.description: Insert after this cell UUID; required when notebook is non-empty.

folded.description: Hide the new cell's code, showing only its output (Pluto fold). Use for markdown/prose cells. Default: false.

run_after.description: Run the new cell after inserting (non-blocking). Default: false.

name: add_cell

description: Delete a cell from the notebook. Cells that depend on it re-run, so this runs notebook code. Irreversible within the session.
name: delete_cell

description: Run a specific cell (Shift+Enter). Default wait_for_completion=false queues the run and returns immediately (poll read_cell); pass true only when a synchronous result is required on a durable session.

wait_for_completion.description: Block until the cell finishes. Default: false (non-blocking; preferred for stdio-bound sessions).

name: execute_cell

description: Run all staged (dirty) cells, like Cmd+S in Pluto. Runs reactive dependents automatically. Explicit cell_ids must be in pending_run unless force=true. Default wait_for_completion=false queues the run and clears pending_run in the background; poll read_cell / read_notebook_code for completion. Pass true only when a synchronous result is required on a durable session.

cell_ids.description: Optional subset of cell IDs to run; defaults to all pending staged cells.

force.description: Allow running cell_ids not in pending_run. Default: false.

wait_for_completion.description: Block until cells finish. Default: false (non-blocking; preferred for stdio-bound sessions).

name: submit_changes

description: Re-run all cells in the notebook in dependency order. Clears pending_run when execution finishes. Default wait_for_completion=false queues the run; pass true to block until done. Prefer submit_changes for staged agent edits.

wait_for_completion.description: Block until all cells finish. Default: false.

name: run_all_cells

description: Reorder a cell relative to another. Pass an empty string for after_cell_id to move to the top.

after_cell_id.description: Move after this cell UUID; pass "" to move to top.

name: move_cell

description: Fold or unfold a cell: folded hides the code editor and shows only the output (Pluto's eye toggle). Metadata only; nothing runs. Persisted in the notebook file.

folded.description: true to hide the code, false to show it.

name: fold_cell

description: Return the notebook as a single code string with cell markers. Default order is execution (dependency) order; use order=visual for UI layout order. Counts as a read of every cell it returns, for edit_cell, edit_cells, and add_cell's after_cell_id. Leaves out Pluto's package-environment cells and, unless include_markdown=true, md"..." cells.

include_markdown.description: Include markdown cells as # md: prefixed blocks. Default: false.

order.description: Cell ordering for projection. Default: execution.

name: read_notebook_code

description: Return cell IDs in visual (UI) order.
name: get_cell_order

description: Return cell IDs in execution (dependency) order.
name: get_execution_order

description: Return upstream cell IDs and referenced symbols for a cell. For reactivity debugging, not the default edit workflow.
name: get_cell_dependencies

description: Return downstream cell IDs that would re-run if this cell changes (transitive). For reactivity debugging.
name: get_cell_dependents

description: Find cells where a symbol is defined (semantic analysis). For debugging, not default workflow.
name: find_symbol_definitions

description: Find cells that reference a symbol (semantic analysis). Differs from search_code text search.
name: find_symbol_references

description: Validate proposed cell code (parse + single-expression rules) before edit_cell. Does not mutate the notebook.

cell_id.description: The cell UUID (used for parse context).

name: validate_cell

description: Text search across all cell codes. Returns snippets; unlike find_symbol_references, matches comments and shadowed names.
name: search_code

description: Use only when the user asks to keep the notebook running. Notebooks otherwise stop after a stretch with no tool calls, edits, or running cells (the user sets how long). keep=true exempts this notebook until you call it with keep=false or the notebook is stopped.

keep.description: true keeps it running; false lets it stop when idle again.

name: keep_notebook_alive

description: Return whether Pluto is running, open notebooks, and (when managed) session_id plus mcp/pluto URLs.
name: pluto_session_status

description: Load a .jl notebook file into the live Pluto session (user-confirmed path). Default safe preview (no auto-run); set run_notebook=true to queue a single non-blocking full run; don't also call run_all_cells, which would run it twice. Each session works on one notebook: once it has one, opening a different path is refused (read other notebooks as plain .jl files instead).

path.description: Filesystem path to the notebook .jl file.

run_notebook.description: Queue a non-blocking full run after open. Default: false (safe preview).

name: open_notebook

description: Create a new empty notebook file (written by Pluto itself) and load it into the live Pluto session, ready to run (no safe preview: it has no code yet). It starts with one empty cell, whose id is in cell_ids: edit it for the first cell. Use this instead of writing a .jl file by hand. Omit path to get a Pluto-named file in the session's folder; an existing file is never overwritten (use open_notebook for that). Each session works on one notebook: if it already has one, this is refused. For a new analysis step, add a section to the current notebook rather than creating another.

path.description: Optional filesystem path for the new .jl file; a relative path is inside the session's folder. Must not exist yet; its directory must.

name: new_notebook

description: Exit safe preview on an open notebook (same as the user clicking "Run notebook code" in the pane). Use when the user explicitly asks to run the notebook. Default run_notebook=true queues a single non-blocking full run (poll read_cell for completion). run_notebook=false exits the gate without queuing a run.

run_notebook.description: Queue a non-blocking full run after allowing execution. Default: true. false exits safe preview only.

name: allow_execution
